title: Looking for feedback for the Battle Overhaul & Skills update for our AI-RPG: Battle, Die, Repeat!
author: Lemon30
selftext:
Now that summer is over we are back to work on Battle, Die, Repeat! A lot has changed since [my last post here](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/14cspf0/looking_for_feedback_for_our_airpg_battle_die/).

Here’s a rundown of what’s new:

1. **Updated Battle Mechanics**:
   - A more engaging [battle system](https://imgur.com/EoOSpYr) is now in place with heroes having a basic attack that scales based on their stats. 
   - The damage of each attack are influenced by the stats and runes used to summon the hero.
  
2. **Skill Crafting Introduced**:
   - Get ready to delve into the art of [skill](https://imgur.com/QYaafmr) crafting, a feature that will provide a deeper layer of strategy to your battles. 
   
3. **Equipable Skills for Heroes**:
   - Your heroes can now be [equipped with crafted skills](https://imgur.com/qBKwVlq), enhancing their combat effectiveness and allowing for more strategic gameplay.
   
4. **Updated Enemy Stats**:
   - Enemies have undergone a stat rebalance to provide a more challenging yet fair battlefield.

Our next milestones include:

1. Daily login, battle, and challenge rewards.
2. Type advantage/disadvantages based on the runes. This should make encounters more tactical.
3. Balance! The balance is way off right now because of the new combat overhaul.
4. Add heal, shield, status effects, etc. to the skills. These are already being generated but not used during the battle yet.

Please give it a try and let us know how you feel about the whole project. We are dedicated to making a fun game where your creativity and imagination will shine. We'll need time, your patience and a lot of feedback.

Check it on [Android Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.arworlds.battle_die_repeat_app).

Best,  
Lemon30

comments.author: Pinkybeard
comments.body: Hey, I just downloaded your game. It's taking to much time to summon hero at the current time. It's not clear either if it's interesting to mix runes of different rarities to gain better attributes.

replies.author: Lemon30
replies.body:
Hey, thanks for your feedback! 

- Hero summons shouldn't take more than 20 seconds. How long did it take for you?

- That's a good point about rune rarities. They determine the max amount of attributes you can get but you are right about it being unclear. I'll add an indicator to the UI.

Best,
Lemon
